elements.source: Royal Society of Chemistry, Periodic Table : https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/69/thulium

elements.source: Royal Society of Chemistry, Periodic Table : https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/92/uranium

elements.source: Royal Society of Chemistry, Periodic Table : https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/93/neptunium
